## Rules

| Rule ID | Strength | Phases | Probe | Assertion |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `figure.width.single` | required | live, file | `artifact.width_mm` | approx `89` mm |
| `figure.width.double` | required | live, file | `artifact.width_mm` | approx `183` mm |
| `figure.max_height` | required | live, file | `artifact.height_mm` | lte `170` mm |
| `font.family` | required | live | `font.families.effective` | subset `Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif` |
| `font.size.min` | required | live | `font.size.min_pt` | gte `5` pt |
| `font.size.max` | required | live | `font.size.max_pt` | lte `7` pt |
| `font.size.target` | recommended | live | `font.size.max_pt` | eq `7` pt |
| `line.width.min` | required | live | `line.width.min_pt` | gte `0.25` pt |
| `figure.title.prohibited` | recommended | live | `figure.has_title` | eq `False` |
| `font.pdf.type3.prohibited` | required | file | `pdf.type3_font_count` | eq `0` |
| `font.pdf.embedding.required` | required | file | `pdf.unembedded_font_count` | eq `0` |
| `export.formats.vector` | required | file | `artifact.format` | in `pdf, eps, svg` |
| `export.formats.halftone` | recommended | file | `artifact.format` | in `jpeg, tiff` |
| `export.min_dpi.halftone` | recommended | file | `artifact.dpi` | gte `300` dpi |
